account.boundDescription: Nintendo Account · New album screenshots sync when you open the site
account.failures: {count} screenshot could not be imported | {count} screenshots could not be imported
account.lastRun: Last recognition: {time} · {count} screenshot | Last recognition: {time} · {count} screenshots
account.note: Opening the site checks the album for new screenshots, except within 3 minutes of the last update. Updates are at least 10 seconds apart. The cloud album keeps at most 100 files for 30 days, so open the site regularly to sync.
account.unbindDescription: This removes the Nintendo sign-in saved in this browser and stops automatic updates. Recorded scores are kept, and screenshots that were already processed will not be imported again if you link later.
account.unbound: Nintendo Account unlinked. Recorded scores are kept.

bind.title: Link Nintendo Account
bind.noticeIntro: Once linked, opening this site automatically reads GCFP screenshots from your Nintendo Switch App album, recognizes them on this device and records the scores. Please read the following before linking.

unofficial.title: Unofficial integration
unofficial.text: The album is read through unofficial APIs that may stop working after Nintendo updates. We cannot guarantee that your account is free of risk. Decide for yourself whether to link.

thirdParty.title: Who handles your data
thirdParty.text: Cloudflare handles sign-in credentials, the album list and screenshots in transit. The third-party service nxapi-znca-api processes Nintendo identity tokens, Coral tokens and request contents before and after encryption. This site does not store them on its server.

storage.title: Credentials and scores
storage.text: Sign-in credentials are encrypted and stored in a cookie in this browser for 30 days, unreadable by page scripts. Recognized scores are saved only on this device.

scope.title: What is read
scope.text: Only GCFP screenshots uploaded from Switch 2 to Nintendo Switch App are read. The cloud album keeps at most 100 files for 30 days; expired or unuploaded screenshots cannot be read.

bind.consent: I have read and understand the risks and data handling above
bind.loginIntro: Finish linking in three steps. The sign-in link is valid for 10 minutes and can be regenerated.

login.title: Sign in to Nintendo
login.text: Select “Go to sign-in” and sign in to the Nintendo Account you want to link on the page that opens.

copy.title: Copy the link
copy.text: After signing in, an account selection button (such as “Select this person”) appears. Do not click it. Right-click it (long-press on mobile) and choose “Copy link address”.

paste.title: Paste it here
paste.text: Come back to this page, paste the copied link below and select “Finish linking”.

bind.pasteFailed: Unable to read the clipboard. Paste the link manually.
bind.invalidLink: The link should start with npf. Copy the link of the account selection button.
bind.safety: This link can be used to sign in to your account. Do not share it. On mobile the button may open Nintendo Switch App, so linking on a computer is recommended.
bind.successNote: GCFP screenshots in your album will be read and recorded shortly
